headline: Toni Collette Directs Film Debut The Best Of
post:
Exciting news from Screen Australia! Award-winning star Toni Collette is stepping behind the camera to make her feature directing debut with "The Best Of." This project is her screen adaptation of the bestselling novel by Graeme Simsion.

It is one of 75 projects receiving production and development funding, backed by more than AUD16.9 million total. Collette is also producing the film alongside Christopher Simon. 

Are you looking forward to seeing this book come to life on screen?

#ToniCollette #TheBestOf #ScreenAustralia
original_title: Toni Collette’s Directorial Debut ‘The Best Of’ Among 75 Projects Backed by Screen Australia

headline: Jackson Olson Jokes About Being Canceled
post:
Hey friends! Jackson Olson is poking a bit of fun at his recent social media drama. The Dancing With the Stars contestant recently joked in a video that he was “canceled” after sparking controversy for a jab at costar Guillermo Rodriguez's dancing abilities.

Things got a bit rocky when the Savannah Bananas star left a since-deleted comment questioning how someone else did a routine better than Rodriguez, according to Cosmopolitan. Olson has since publicly apologized and shared that the two cleared the air after talking things out in person.

To add to his humorous list of recent woes, the athlete also joked about losing a championship game and watching his pro dance partner Emma Slater leave the studio. E! News reported that Olson and Rodriguez have cleared the air and remain on good terms. 🍌

Have you been keeping up with this season's dance routines?

#DWTS #JacksonOlson #GuillermoRodriguez
original_title: Jackson Olson Reacts to Being "Canceled" Over Guillermo Rodriguez Diss

headline: Breaking Bad Star RJ Mitte Dies At 34
post:
Following the passing of RJ Mitte at the age of 34, his Breaking Bad co-stars have shared heartfelt tributes. A representative confirmed that the actor died of suicide on Monday.

Mitte was widely celebrated for portraying Walter White Jr. on the acclaimed series and for his advocacy work for performers with disabilities. Bryan Cranston shared a moving tribute remembering his onscreen son.

Further updates will follow.

#RJMitte #BreakingBad #Tribute
original_title: ‘Breaking Bad’ Star Bryan Cranston and Others Mourn RJ Mitte: ‘I’ll Miss You, Son’

headline: Dionne Warwick cancels Carnegie Hall show
post:
Legendary singer Dionne Warwick had to step back from a weekend performance. The iconic artist was scheduled to appear at a charity benefit in New York City, according to Page Six.

However, she faced severe mobility issues. She explained in a statement that her "leg and foot would not allow me to stand nor walk at the moment." Because of this intense discomfort, she chose to focus on rest and recovery instead.

Organizers quickly found a replacement, bringing in cabaret veteran Marilyn Maye to fill the spot for the evening. We certainly wish her a smooth and speedy recovery!

What is your all-time favorite song by this legendary artist? 🎶

#DionneWarwick #CarnegieHall #PageSix
original_title: Dionne Warwick, 85, cancels Carnegie Hall performance due to severe pain, gives heartfelt apology

headline: Breaking Bad star RJ Mitte passes away
post:
Law enforcement responded to the Texas home of Breaking Bad actor RJ Mitte following his tragic death on Monday. Authorities blocked the street and put up yellow crime scene tape as the investigation remains ongoing.

The late actor was known for his role as Walter White Jr. and his advocacy for disability awareness. His upcoming film, Forgotten Outlaw, has been put on hold following the news.

Updates will follow as more information becomes available.

#Entertainment #Hollywood #PopCulture
original_title: RJ Mitte Death: Police Block Street Outside Texas Home Where Actor Was Found Dead
